title: Garibaldi, born in Nice
episode: Giuseppe Garibaldi: One of the Greatest Generals of Modern Times
description: Giuseppe Garibaldi, the soldier who led the fight to unite Italy, was born in Nice in 1807. He never forgave the deal that handed his city from the Kingdom of Sardinia to France in 1860. His statue stands in the square named for him.

title: The carnival
episode: Biggest carnival in France: “Carnaval de Nice” anniversary edition | French Riviera Travel Guide
description: Nice’s carnival, one of the biggest in the world, held every February with giant papier-mâché figures paraded through Place Masséna and a battle of flowers on the Promenade. Its modern parades date from 1873.
